thesis: The episode introduces Vanguard as the largest provider of index funds in the United States, which effectively created the first index fund for individual investors in 1975. It highlights that Vanguard is owned exclusively by its customers, not publicly traded, and has saved investors over $500 billion in fees since its founding, forcing the rest of the industry to cut their fees as well.
